limitations: The packet lacks representative evaluations jointly measuring novelty and functional compliance.

Selected failures and partial successes cannot establish the claimed recurring tendency.

statement.excerpt: They (often) don’t come up with a novel independent design that would meet the requirements.

from_speaker: design to used with only one hand
our_interpretation: In context, they refers principally to contemporary generative image systems given unfamiliar design briefs.
Often means a recurring tendency, not an invented requirement that more than half of all outputs fail.
Success requires both meaningful novelty and compliance with the brief's functional constraints.
The target is the latest publicly documented performance of systems available before publication; no fixed reporting interval or starting date is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Repeated evaluations across relevant design briefs show substantial recurring failures to produce both novel and functionally compliant designs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations show reliable novel, compliant designs and establish that the alleged failures are isolated or unrepresentative.

evidence.explanation: The benchmark documents relevant instruction-following failures and separately studies creative generation. These measures do not directly establish how often novel functional designs satisfy product briefs.

The original demonstrator reports partial successes as well as failures on unusual object prompts. This cautions against inferring inability from selected failures, but the demonstration does not provide a representative frequency estimate.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Representative evaluations of systems available before February 8, 2024 across unfamiliar design briefs, recording model versions, prompts, permitted prompting effort and every sampled output, with separate assessments of novelty and functional compliance.
